about: Modwerk source-only sample-rate package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/sample-rate.

mods.title: Improved SMPL
mods.summary: The SAMPLE page, improved: TUN turns in cents, FIN's knob is RATE (pure sample speed, to a stop and into reverse), and SMPL always shows the waveform, with the values that matter in one row.
mods.description: The SAMPLE page, improved: TUN turns in cents, FIN's knob is RATE (pure sample speed, to a stop and into reverse), and SMPL always shows the waveform, with the values that matter in one row.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: This source ran on the author's Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 in the author's private combo image RC40, flashed by hand (RC38 and RC39 carried earlier 0.5.0 builds); this package has not run alone on a unit.
